name: smwgraphics-parodius-non-sense-fantasy-japan
title: Parodius: Non-Sense Fantasy - Japan
description:
I'm back with an update of this BG. This includes the addition of the sun, which uses an extra palette. Included is the 'angry' version of the palette. The shining sun part can be easily removed to save 1 palette. Despite the volcanoes looking happy in the BG, the volcanoes in the FG are angry.
No credit needed.
